description: Emulation driver code for the Microchip MCP7940N RTC/Battery RAM, implementing I2C communication and data handling for testing purposes.

methods.name: mcp7940n_emul_init
methods.description: Initialization function for the MCP7940N emulator, currently a no-op.

methods.name: mcp7940n_emul_transfer_i2c
methods.description: Handles I2C transfer operations, including read and write to emulated registers and SRAM.

methods.name: mcp7940n_emul_backend_set_data
methods.description: Sets data in the emulated SRAM at specified offset.

methods.name: mcp7940n_emul_backend_get_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from the emulated SRAM at specified offset.
